decisions.reason: The request adds a dimension annotation for the en-suite bathroom and does not change kitchen cabinetry.
Showing the en-suite wall-to-door-edge dimension does not alter the location, construction, or removal of any partition wall.
The source concerns the en-suite bathroom dimension annotation, not Unit 3 bathroom geometry or fixtures.
The requested dimension annotation does not change the common corridor layout or its unresolved design alternatives.

The en-suite is the measured subject, but the source only requests that a wall-to-door-edge dimension be shown; it does not change the bathroom's geometry, fixtures, or other product-state attributes.
Adding the wall-to-door-edge measurement to the drawing does not resolve or modify the bathroom door type, opening direction, clearance, or collision issue.
The source requests an en-suite door-edge dimension and has no effect on Unit 3 toilet drain routing.
